Space Planning & Smart Layouts

Make room for the things you need, with a layout that is easy to use.

Made for your space

Make better use of your space.

Space planning means choosing where things go in a room. We plan furniture, seating and storage so people can move around easily. We work with homes, salons, offices and business spaces across Kenya.

How we can help

  • Furniture and seating layouts
  • Space for people to move
  • Storage ideas for your room
  • Plans based on how you use the space
